List the pull requests linked to an issue. Read-only.

Usage: multica issue <command>

Commands:
  get, list, search, create, comment, status, assign, update, pull-requests, runs, run-messages, cancel-task, rerun, label, metadata

`multica issue pull-requests <id>` lists the pull requests linked to an issue. There is no command that links a pull request.
